entries.en: Residents may take exception to the proposal for a taller boundary wall.
entries.zh: 居民们可能会反对加高围墙的提案。

entries.en: Please take heed of the warnings beside the damaged steps.
entries.zh: 请注意破损台阶旁的警告。

entries.en: I must take issue with your estimate of the repair costs.
entries.zh: 我必须对你估算的维修费用提出异议。

entries.en: Take it from me, those shoes won't last a winter.
entries.zh: 相信我的话，那双鞋撑不过一个冬天。

entries.en: We stopped at the cottage to take leave of our hosts.
entries.zh: 我们在小屋停留，向主人们告别。

entries.en: Take my word for it, the path becomes much steeper ahead.
entries.zh: 相信我的话，前面的路会陡得多。

entries.en: The persistent salesman refused to take no for an answer.
entries.zh: 那个纠缠不休的推销员拒绝接受否定答复。

entries.en: She tried to take no notice of the whispering behind her.
entries.zh: 她尽量不去注意身后的窃窃私语。

entries.en: You should take note of the different dates on these invoices.
entries.zh: 你应该注意到这些发票上的不同日期。

entries.en: The cat refused to take notice of our calls.
entries.zh: 那只猫不肯理睬我们的呼唤。

entries.en: The council needs to take on board the residents' objections.
entries.zh: 市政当局需要考虑居民的反对意见。

entries.en: Several retired teachers volunteered to take part in the reading project.
entries.zh: 几位退休教师自愿参加这个阅读项目。

entries.en: Would you take pity on the hungry kitten at the gate?
entries.zh: 你会怜悯门口那只饥饿的小猫吗？

entries.en: We didn't book a room and had to take pot luck.
entries.zh: 我们没有订房，只能有什么就接受什么。

entries.en: The mediator refused to take sides in the neighbours' argument.
entries.zh: 调解人拒绝在邻居们的争吵中偏袒任何一方。

entries.en: She was reluctant to take someone to court over a broken fence.
entries.zh: 她不愿因为围栏坏了就起诉别人。

entries.en: It was unlike her to take something as read without any evidence.
entries.zh: 在毫无证据的情况下就认定某件事是真的，这不像她平时的作风。

entries.en: The journalist refused to take the bait when the spokesman made a personal remark.
entries.zh: 发言人发表针对个人的言论时，那位记者没有上当。

entries.en: The treasurer agreed to take the chair for the emergency meeting.
entries.zh: 财务主管同意担任紧急会议的主席。

entries.en: If you ignore the deadline, you must take the consequences.
entries.zh: 如果你无视截止日期，就必须承担后果。

entries.en: One neighbour decided to take the initiative and organise a cleanup.
entries.zh: 一位邻居决定带头组织一次清扫。

entries.en: The trustees must take the long view when planning repairs.
entries.zh: 受托人在安排修缮时必须从长远着想。

entries.en: The defending team decided to take the offensive after halftime.
entries.zh: 原本防守的球队决定在中场休息后采取攻势。

entries.en: Don't take the piss out of him for asking a reasonable question.
entries.zh: 别因为他问了一个合理的问题就取笑他。

entries.en: After years of renting flats, they decided to take the plunge and buy one.
entries.zh: 租公寓多年之后，他们决定冒险尝试买一套。

entries.en: He refused to take the rap for a robbery he hadn't committed.
entries.zh: 他拒绝为一起自己没有犯下的抢劫案承担刑事责任。

entries.term: take the rough with the smooth
entries.en: Running a small shop means learning to take the rough with the smooth.
entries.zh: 经营小店意味着要学会既能享乐，也能吃苦。

entries.en: We can take things easy until the next delivery arrives.
entries.zh: 下一批货送到之前，我们可以慢慢来。

entries.en: You can take time over the repairs; there is no deadline.
entries.zh: 维修可以从容进行，没有截止日期。

entries.en: The editor was willing to take up the cudgels for the inexperienced reporter.
entries.zh: 编辑愿意尽力维护那位缺乏经验的记者。

entries.en: The rival team was quick to take up the gauntlet.
entries.zh: 对手球队很快就接受了挑战。

entries.en: I was surprised to see him take up with the suspicious stranger.
entries.zh: 看到他与那个可疑的陌生人亲密交往，我很惊讶。

entries.en: The child was punished for continuing to talk back.
entries.zh: 那个孩子因为不断顶嘴而受到惩罚。

entries.en: We need to talk out the disagreement before signing any documents.
entries.zh: 我们需要先通过商谈消除分歧，再签署文件。

entries.en: He tried to talk round the question without revealing the price.
entries.zh: 他想围绕问题兜圈子，不透露价格。

entries.en: The agent tried to talk up the house's unusual layout.
entries.zh: 中介试图赞扬那栋房子不同寻常的布局。

entries.en: He used a reel-to-reel machine to tape-record the interview.
entries.zh: 他用开盘式录音机把访谈录到磁带上。

entries.en: The archivist needed time to tease out the dates from the damaged letters.
entries.zh: 档案管理员需要时间，才能从受损的信件里逐渐理出日期。

entries.en: The mill hired two workers to teazel the woollen cloth.
entries.zh: 工厂雇了两名工人给毛呢拉绒。

entries.en: They still teazle the fabric by hand in that workshop.
entries.zh: 那间作坊仍然手工给织物起绒。

entries.en: Only one room remains available, that is, the attic bedroom.
entries.zh: 只剩一个房间可用，那就是阁楼卧室。

entries.en: If you fold the map that way, the tear gets worse.
entries.zh: 如果你那样折地图，裂口会变得更大。

entries.en: We heard an owl near the orchard the night before last.
entries.zh: 前天晚上，我们听见果园附近有猫头鹰叫。

entries.en: I found your missing glove beneath the bench the other day.
entries.zh: 前几天，我在长椅底下找到了你丢失的手套。

entries.en: You have the dates the other way round on this label.
entries.zh: 你把这个标签上的日期顺序弄反了。

entries.en: The two sisters dress the same despite living far apart.
entries.zh: 两姐妹虽然住得相距很远，穿着打扮却一样。

entries.en: She dreams of selling her paintings the world over.
entries.zh: 她梦想把自己的画销往世界各地。

entries.en: She decided then and there to return the damaged suitcase.
entries.zh: 她当场就决定退还那个损坏的手提箱。

entries.en: The landlord agreed there and then to replace the broken lock.
entries.zh: 房东当场就同意更换坏锁。

entries.en: Questions came thick and fast once the audience heard the announcement.
entries.zh: 观众听到宣布的消息后，问题接二连三地涌来。

entries.en: A little warm stock should thin down the sauce.
entries.zh: 少许温热的高汤应该能把酱汁调稀。

entries.en: I sometimes think aloud when I'm solving a difficult puzzle.
entries.zh: 解一道困难的谜题时，我有时会边想边说。

entries.en: She would think nothing of cycling twenty miles to visit a friend.
entries.zh: 她会把骑二十英里去看朋友当作平常事。

entries.en: They sailed third-class to save money for the return journey.
entries.zh: 他们乘三等舱航行，好省下回程的钱。

entries.en: Hold the fabric this way so the pattern stays straight.
entries.zh: 这样拿着布料，图案才会保持端正。

entries.en: The crew supported one another through thick and thin.
entries.zh: 船员们不畏艰险，互相支持。

entries.en: He had to throw aside the wet blanket before lifting the box.
entries.zh: 他得先把湿毯子扔到一边，再抬起箱子。

entries.en: Please don't throw down your tools on the tiled floor.
entries.zh: 请不要把工具扔到瓷砖地板上。

entries.en: The old diary may throw light on the family's sudden departure.
entries.zh: 那本旧日记可能有助于弄清这家人突然离开的原因。

entries.en: Heavy apples were thudding onto the grass beneath the tree.
entries.zh: 沉甸甸的苹果正砰砰地落到树下的草地上。

entries.en: You can thumb through the catalogue while I fetch the samples.
entries.zh: 我去取样品时，你可以翻翻目录。

entries.en: The committee gave the redesign a definite thumbs down.
entries.zh: 委员会明确表示反对这次重新设计。

entries.en: The coach was ticking off the players for arriving late.
entries.zh: 教练正在斥责迟到的球员。

entries.en: They hope to tie the knot before the renovation is finished.
entries.zh: 他们希望在翻修工程结束前结婚。

entries.en: She tied a blue ribbon around the parcel.
entries.zh: 她在包裹上系了一条蓝色缎带。

entries.en: Time after time, the same key failed to open the door.
entries.zh: 那把钥匙一次又一次地没能打开门。

entries.en: The terminals time-share a central processor during the demonstration.
entries.zh: 演示时，各终端分时使用一个中央处理器。

entries.en: Timetabling became difficult once the two classes shared a laboratory.
entries.zh: 两个班共用一间实验室之后，编排时间表变得困难了。

entries.en: The loose seat can tip up if you lean too far forward.
entries.zh: 如果你身体过于前倾，松动的座椅就会向上翻起。

entries.en: By sunset, the gardeners were tired out but pleased with their work.
entries.zh: 日落时，园丁们虽然筋疲力尽，却对自己的工作很满意。

entries.en: To be fair, nobody had warned him about the faulty switch.
entries.zh: 公平地说，没人告诉过他那个开关有毛病。

entries.en: To be frank, the revised design looks less practical.
entries.zh: 坦率地说，修改后的设计看起来更不实用了。

entries.en: He decorated the small room to excess with mirrors and gilding.
entries.zh: 他用镜子和镀金装饰把那个小房间装饰得过了头。

entries.en: We searched the muddy path for the lost ring, to little avail.
entries.zh: 我们在泥泞的小路上寻找丢失的戒指，却没什么收获。

entries.en: To start with, we need a reliable count of the missing books.
entries.zh: 首先，我们得准确清点丢失的书籍数量。

entries.en: Could you top up the birdbath before we leave?
entries.zh: 出发前，你能把鸟浴盆里的水加满吗？

entries.meaningZh: 咬紧牙关挺过〔美式口语〕
entries.en: The crew decided to tough out the difficult final week.
entries.zh: 船员们决定咬紧牙关挺过艰难的最后一周。

entries.en: We can trace back the error through these records.
entries.zh: 通过这些记录，我们可以追溯这个错误的来历。

entries.en: The two typists agreed to trade off using the only keyboard.
entries.zh: 两位打字员同意交替使用唯一的键盘。

entries.en: The seller tried to trade on my trust in his father.
entries.zh: 卖家试图利用我对他父亲的信任。

entries.en: They hope to trade up to a larger car next year.
entries.zh: 他们希望明年换购一辆更大、更贵的汽车。

entries.en: Her voice began to trail off as she noticed the empty seats.
entries.zh: 她注意到那些空座位后，话音开始渐弱而停下。

entries.en: The workshop hopes to train up two new furniture restorers.
entries.zh: 作坊希望培养两名新的家具修复人员。

entries.en: We decided to travel light and leave the heavy camera behind.
entries.zh: 我们决定轻装旅行，不带那部沉重的相机。

entries.en: You mustn't trifle with her feelings just to entertain your friends.
entries.zh: 你不能为了逗朋友开心就玩弄她的感情。

entries.en: Use the small scissors to trim off the loose threads.
entries.zh: 用小剪刀剪掉松散的线头。

entries.en: The boys were truanting when the caretaker found them behind the gym.
entries.zh: 管理员在体育馆后面发现那些男孩时，他们正在逃课。

entries.en: True to form, he arrived after everyone else had finished eating.
entries.zh: 一如既往，其他人都吃完了，他才到。

entries.en: Don't trust to luck when the gate needs a proper lock.
entries.zh: 大门需要一把合适的锁时，别指望运气。

entries.en: You can tuck up the hem to keep it out of the mud.
entries.zh: 你可以把下摆折起来，免得沾到泥。

entries.en: Loose stones could tumble down the slope onto the path.
entries.zh: 松动的石头可能从斜坡上滚落到小路上。

entries.en: A hurried visitor could tumble over that loose cable.
entries.zh: 匆忙的访客可能会在那根松散的电缆处绊一跤。

entries.en: The witnesses began to turn against the organiser after hearing the recording.
entries.zh: 听过录音后，证人们开始转而反对组织者。

entries.en: He promised to turn over a new leaf after his release.
entries.zh: 获释后，他答应改过自新。

entries.en: Please turn round slowly so I can check the back of the coat.
entries.zh: 请慢慢转身，好让我检查外套的背面。

entries.en: It turns out that the missing invoice was filed under my name.
entries.zh: 原来那张丢失的发票归档在我的名字下面。

entries.en: Please type in the reference number shown on the website.
entries.zh: 请输入网站上显示的参考编号。

entries.en: The old terminal began to type out the results on paper.
entries.zh: 旧终端开始把结果打印到纸上。

entries.en: The shopkeeper admitted selling the scarce tickets under the counter.
entries.zh: 店主承认私下出售那些紧俏的票。

entries.en: The apprentices painted under the influence of their teacher's early work.
entries.zh: 学徒们受老师早期作品的影响作画。

entries.en: The council had under-funded the library for several years.
entries.zh: 市政当局连续几年都没有给图书馆提供足够的资金。

entries.en: The firm underpaid its cleaners for several months.
entries.zh: 公司连续几个月都没有足额支付清洁工的工资。

entries.en: She unplugged the lamp before moving the desk.
entries.zh: 她先拔掉台灯的电源插头，再挪动书桌。

entries.en: Warm water helped us unstick the two nested bowls.
entries.zh: 温水帮助我们把两个套在一起的碗分开。

entries.en: The workshop asks customers to pay a small deposit up front.
entries.zh: 作坊要求顾客预先支付一小笔订金。

entries.en: Our repair brought the old projector up to par.
entries.zh: 我们的维修使那台旧放映机达到了标准。

entries.en: We watched the small tug head up-river before sunrise.
entries.zh: 日出前，我们看着那艘小拖船驶向上游。

entries.en: They played the wedding march uptempo for the comic scene.
entries.zh: 为了那场喜剧戏，他们快速演奏了婚礼进行曲。

entries.en: His elaborate excuses began to verge on the ridiculous.
entries.zh: 他精心编造的借口开始近乎荒谬。

entries.en: The committee is vetting applications for the caretaker's position.
entries.zh: 委员会正在审查管理员职位的申请。

entries.en: I had time to visit with the neighbours before the bus arrived.
entries.zh: 公共汽车到达前，我有时间和邻居们聊一聊。

entries.en: I cannot vouch for every detail of his account.
entries.zh: 我无法担保他叙述中的每一处细节。

entries.en: She was reluctant to wade in before hearing both accounts.
entries.zh: 听到双方的说法之前，她不愿插手。

entries.en: We had to wait about while the porter found our luggage.
entries.zh: 搬运工找我们的行李时，我们不得不在附近等候。

entries.en: Let's wait and see whether the revised timetable helps.
entries.zh: 修改时间表是否有用，我们等着瞧吧。

entries.en: You needn't wait around after handing in the keys.
entries.zh: 交了钥匙之后，你不必在附近等候。

entries.en: I'll wait in tomorrow morning for the furniture delivery.
entries.zh: 明天上午我会在家等家具送来。

entries.en: We had to wait in line outside the tiny bakery.
entries.zh: 我们不得不在那家小面包店外排队等候。

entries.en: Please don't wait up if the rehearsal runs late.
entries.zh: 如果排练结束得晚，请别熬夜等我。

entries.en: The favourite could walk away with the prize this year.
entries.zh: 今年那位热门选手可能会轻易获奖。

entries.en: Don't walk into the same trap by answering too quickly.
entries.zh: 别因为回答太快而再次掉进同一个圈套。

entries.en: Someone tried to walk off with the donation box.
entries.zh: 有人试图偷走捐款箱。

entries.en: They plan to wall off the storage area from the workshop.
entries.zh: 他们打算用墙把储物区和作坊隔开。

entries.en: I wanna finish this drawing before the light fades.
entries.zh: 我想在光线暗下去之前完成这幅画。

entries.en: I want out of this cramped room before the meeting begins.
entries.zh: 我想在开会之前离开这个狭小的房间。

entries.en: The runners stayed on the track to warm down after the race.
entries.zh: 比赛后，跑步者留在跑道上做整理活动。

entries.en: The signs warn off visitors who might disturb the nesting birds.
entries.zh: 这些告示让可能打扰筑巢鸟类的访客不要靠近。

entries.en: Waves began to wash over the low wall beside the harbour.
entries.zh: 海浪开始冲过港口旁的矮墙。

entries.en: In the story, the imprisoned king begins to waste away.
entries.zh: 故事中，被囚禁的国王开始消瘦衰弱。

entries.en: Please watch for the blue sign just beyond the bridge.
entries.zh: 请注意刚过桥处的蓝色标牌。

entries.en: Watch it! The handle is still hot.
entries.zh: 小心！把手还烫着呢。

entries.en: Watch out for loose tiles near the cellar steps.
entries.zh: 当心地下室台阶附近松动的瓷砖。

entries.en: She learned to water-ski during a holiday at the lake.
entries.zh: 她在湖边度假时学会了滑水。

entries.en: The objections were easy to wave aside before the accident.
entries.zh: 事故发生前，这些反对意见很容易就被置之不理。

entries.en: The boxers must weigh in before tomorrow's contest.
entries.zh: 拳击手必须在明天的比赛之前称重。

entries.en: Could you weigh out enough flour for two loaves?
entries.zh: 你能称出足够做两条面包的面粉吗？

entries.en: We need to weigh up the risks before moving the collection.
entries.zh: 搬动这些藏品之前，我们需要估量风险。

entries.en: By the time help arrived, the gate was well and truly stuck.
entries.zh: 等人来帮忙时，大门确实卡住了。

entries.en: A bright yellow wheel clamp prevented the van from moving.
entries.zh: 一个鲜黄色的车轮固定夹使那辆厢式车无法移动。

entries.en: The candidate plans to whistle-stop through the county before the election.
entries.zh: 候选人计划在选举前到县内各地开展竞选活动。

entries.en: Patience may win out over anger during a difficult discussion.
entries.zh: 在艰难的讨论中，耐心可能最终战胜愤怒。

entries.en: Despite repeated setbacks, the small team managed to win through.
entries.zh: 尽管屡遭挫折，这个小团队还是历尽艰辛取得了成功。

entries.en: I like to wind down with a quiet walk after work.
entries.zh: 下班后，我喜欢安静地散步，放松一下。

entries.en: Please wipe down the cabinet before putting the dishes away.
entries.zh: 把餐具收好之前，请将柜子擦干净。

entries.meaningZh: 使…输得一败涂地〔非正式〕
entries.en: The visiting team threatened to wipe the floor with the champions.
entries.zh: 客队扬言要让冠军队输得一败涂地。

entries.en: The electrician returned to wire up the new ceiling lights.
entries.zh: 电工回来给新的吸顶灯接通电源。

entries.en: My parents won't hear of me travelling alone at night.
entries.zh: 父母不允许我夜里独自出行。

entries.en: He tried to worm out of cleaning the shared kitchen.
entries.zh: 他想设法逃避打扫共用厨房。

entries.en: An unexpected lob can wrong-foot a tennis player near the net.
entries.zh: 一个意外的高球可能使网前的网球选手脚步乱了套。

entries.en: The noise forced the teacher to yell out the instructions.
entries.zh: 噪声迫使老师大声喊出指令。

entries.meaningZh: 真假嗓音陡然互换地唱
entries.en: The performer was yodelling when the microphone suddenly failed.
entries.zh: 表演者正在用真假嗓音陡然互换地唱歌，麦克风突然坏了。

entries.en: The discussion began to zero in on the missing safety records.
entries.zh: 讨论开始集中到缺失的安全记录上。

entries.en: The fees associated with the property transfer were higher than expected.
entries.zh: 与这次房产转让有关的费用比预期更高。

entries.en: The kitten will be called Pepper, according to the children.
entries.zh: 按孩子们的说法，那只小猫将被叫做“胡椒”。

entries.en: I opened the wrong drawer by accident and found the missing key.
entries.zh: 我偶然拉错了抽屉，找到了丢失的钥匙。

entries.en: The display will consist of six photographs and a handwritten note.
entries.zh: 这次陈列将由六张照片和一张手写便条组成。

entries.en: The rocking boat made me feel sick before we reached the pier.
entries.zh: 船晃得我在到码头之前就想吐了。

entries.en: The discussion can follow on after the short break.
entries.zh: 短暂休息后，讨论可以继续下去。

entries.en: We have to replace the broken hinge before opening the shop.
entries.zh: 开店之前，我们不得不更换坏掉的铰链。

entries.en: No damaged notes were accepted in exchange at that counter.
entries.zh: 那个柜台兑换时不接受破损纸币。

entries.en: Nobody knew how many people were involved in the dispute.
entries.zh: 没人知道有多少人牵涉到这场争议中。

entries.en: The twins found it easy to make friends at the swimming club.
entries.zh: 双胞胎发现，在游泳俱乐部很容易交到朋友。

entries.en: The tenants were opposed to the plan to close the shared garden.
entries.zh: 租户们反对关闭共用花园的计划。

entries.en: You ought to keep a copy of the signed receipt.
entries.zh: 你应该保留一份已签字收据的副本。

entries.en: It's difficult to pay attention when the drill starts up next door.
entries.zh: 隔壁的钻机一响，就很难专心。
